purpose: Independent, fixed reference outputs for native and executed WebAssembly verification. Expected values were not generated from Canteiro functions.

reference_method.allocation: fractions.Fraction on integer cents, largest remainder with stable position then identifier
reference_method.time_zone: zoneinfo.ZoneInfo with round-trip checks for gap/fold local times

format.expected: An output object, or an object containing error with the stable error category. Decimal values are strings, except the deliberate invalid JSON-number input D010.
format.allocation_parts_order: Sort result rows by id before comparison; allocation itself must use position then id for ties, never the input order.
format.time_output: RFC3339 with six microsecond digits and explicit offset
format.property_samples: Each sample has the same request/expected schema as vectors and must be executed on both targets.

scope_notes: Numeric and calendar primitives only. These fixtures do not assert authorization, database concurrency, final financial postings or downstream business workflows.
The 50 determinant cases plus finite property samples are independent references, not a proof over all inputs. Runtime property tests should extend conservation, rejection and deterministic ordering.
Money can represent signed adjustments at the type boundary; ordinary workflows separately enforce permitted signs and approval requirements.
Regional time-zone fixtures depend on the pinned product zone database; any future rules/data update requires explicit review, not regeneration from the product under test.
The existing docs/validacao/vetores-calculo.json and its stateful future-consumer cases are preserved unchanged.
